blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Supreme Court has acquitted of cyberlibel an individual who posted on social media the alleged extortion attempt of a town mayor in Quezon province when her family was seeking permits for a planned fast food chain business. The high court, in a 16-page ruling in January released only on Friday, reversed the conviction of Jade Karla Tan by a regional trial court and the Court of Appeals for posting on her Facebook account defamatory remarks about an unnamed government official.
